title: New Data Shows NHS Trusts Lack Funding for Maternity Leave
subtitle: Physiotherapy teams are being left behind as hospitals struggle to cover staff absences

summary.en: New analysis reveals that nearly half of NHS trusts in England lack specific budgets for maternity leave. This funding gap creates significant challenges for physiotherapy departments. When staff go on leave, remaining team members must often manage the extra workload alone. Experts warn that this leads to longer wait times for patient treatment and rehabilitation. The Chartered Society of Physiotherapy is now calling for fairer funding policies across all clinical professions.
summary.zh: 最新分析顯示，英格蘭近半數的國家醫療保健服務信託機構缺乏產假專用預算。此資金缺口為物理治療部門帶來重大挑戰。當員工請假時，留任的團隊成員往往必須獨自承擔額外的工作量。專家警告，這導致病患在治療與復健上的等待時間拉長。特許物理治療學會目前正呼籲在所有臨床專業中實施更公平的資金政策。

paragraphs.en: New research has highlighted a growing problem within the National Health Service (NHS) in England. Nearly half of all NHS trusts—the organizations that manage local hospitals and health services—do not have dedicated money set aside to pay for staff who are on maternity leave. This means that when a staff member takes time off to have a baby, there is often no budget to hire a temporary replacement. This situation is causing serious concern about the quality of care that patients receive.
paragraphs.zh: 一項新研究凸顯了英格蘭國家醫療保健服務（NHS）內部日益嚴重的問題。近半數的國家醫療保健服務信託機構——即負責管理地方醫院與醫療服務的組織——並未編列專門預算來支付員工產假期間的薪資。這意味著當員工請產假育嬰時，往往沒有預算聘請臨時替代人力。這種情況已引發大眾對於病患所受照護品質的嚴重擔憂。

paragraphs.en: The latest findings come from the Chartered Society of Physiotherapy (CSP), which asked trusts about their financial planning. According to The Guardian Health, the data shows that 49% of trusts have no specific budget or policy that allows them to spend extra money to cover these absences. This is an update to previous reports, which already suggested that many parts of the healthcare system are struggling to manage staff leave effectively.
paragraphs.zh: 這些最新發現來自特許物理治療學會（CSP），該學會針對各信託機構的財務規劃進行了調查。根據《衛報》健康版報導，數據顯示有百分之四十九的信託機構沒有具體的預算或政策，能讓他們額外撥款來填補這些人力缺口。這是對先前報告的更新，而先前的報告早已指出，醫療體系的許多部門在有效管理員工請假方面顯得力不從心。

paragraphs.en: One of the most worrying parts of the report is that physiotherapy services seem to be treated differently than other departments. The analysis found that more than one in five trusts do not provide maternity cover for physiotherapy staff. In contrast, only 9% of trusts reported similar gaps for nursing positions. Ash James, the director of practice and development at the CSP, explained that it is deeply concerning to see such a difference between professions. He noted that when a physiotherapist goes on leave, the patients who need help do not simply disappear. Instead, the remaining team members are forced to take on the extra work, which makes it very difficult to maintain high standards of care.
paragraphs.zh: 這份報告中最令人擔憂的部分之一，是物理治療服務似乎受到與其他部門不同的對待。分析發現，超過五分之一的信託機構沒有為物理治療人員提供產假替代人力。相比之下，護理職位出現類似人力缺口的信託機構僅佔百分之九。特許物理治療學會的執業與發展主任艾許·詹姆斯（Ash James）解釋說，看到不同專業之間存在如此巨大的差異令人深感憂心。他指出，當物理治療師請假時，需要協助的病患並不會因此消失。相反地，留下來的團隊成員被迫承擔額外工作，這使得維持高品質的照護變得極為困難。

paragraphs.en: The impact on patients is direct and significant. Alastair Henderson, the chair of the Patients’ Association, stated that when services are already busy, losing staff without a replacement leads to longer waits for treatment. He added that patients should not have to miss out on the care they need just because the NHS failed to plan for predictable staff absences. Because women make up about 79% of the physiotherapy workforce, this issue affects a large number of employees and the patients who rely on them for rehabilitation.
paragraphs.zh: 這對病患造成的影響是直接且顯著的。病患協會主席阿拉斯泰爾·韓德森（Alastair Henderson）表示，當醫療服務本已繁忙，若失去員工卻沒有替代人力，將導致治療等待時間拉長。他補充說，病患不應僅因為國家醫療保健服務未能針對可預見的員工請假進行規劃，就必須錯失所需的照護。由於女性約佔物理治療人力資源的百分之七十九，此問題影響了大量的員工以及依賴他們進行復健的病患。

paragraphs.en: This funding gap is happening at a time when the NHS is already facing many other challenges. The CSP reports that these problems are made worse by recruitment freezes—periods where hospitals are not allowed to hire new staff—and a general lack of resources. Earlier studies have shown that physiotherapy teams are already struggling with a lack of space and equipment. In a recent survey of over 2,000 CSP members, six out of 10 said that their rehabilitation rooms had been taken over by other clinical teams, often because managers did not prioritize their work.
paragraphs.zh: 此資金缺口出現之際，正值國家醫療保健服務面臨許多其他挑戰之時。特許物理治療學會指出，這些問題因凍結招募——即醫院不被允許聘僱新進員工的時期——以及資源普遍匱乏而更加惡化。先前的研究顯示，物理治療團隊早已面臨空間與設備不足的困境。在近期針對超過兩千名學會成員的調查中，有六成受訪者表示他們的復健室已被其他臨床團隊佔用，這通常是因為管理階層並未優先考量他們的工作需求。

paragraphs.en: These combined pressures mean that patients who have suffered strokes or other serious conditions may not get the intensive support they need. When there are fewer staff members available and less space to work in, the quality of rehabilitation often suffers. The CSP is now calling for urgent action from the government. They want to see an end to recruitment freezes and a requirement that all NHS trusts provide fair and equal access to maternity cover funding for all clinical professions.
paragraphs.zh: 這些綜合壓力意味著，中風或其他重症患者可能無法獲得所需的密集支援。當可用的人力減少且工作空間不足時，復健品質往往會受到影響。特許物理治療學會目前正呼籲政府採取緊急行動。他們希望終止凍結招募的措施，並要求所有國家醫療保健服務信託機構，必須為所有臨床專業提供公平且平等的產假替代人力資金。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the situation remains difficult for both staff and patients. As the NHS continues to face high demand for care, the ability to plan for staff absences will be essential. Without a change in how funding is managed, experts warn that the pressure on remaining teams will only continue to grow. For now, the focus remains on whether the government will listen to these concerns and provide the necessary support to keep essential services running smoothly for everyone.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，對於員工與病患而言，情況依然嚴峻。隨著國家醫療保健服務持續面臨龐大的照護需求，規劃員工請假的能力將至關重要。專家警告，若資金管理方式不變，留任團隊所承受的壓力只會持續增加。目前，焦點仍放在政府是否會傾聽這些擔憂，並提供必要的支援，以確保各項基本醫療服務能為所有人順利運作。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Financial provision or a person acting as a substitute for someone who is absent.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （財務上的）補貼，或指替代缺席者的人員。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（覆蓋），這裡作名詞，指代補足人力或預算的安排。文中：The analysis found that more than one in five trusts do not provide maternity cover for physiotherapy staff.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To accept or agree to do extra work or responsibility.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 承擔（額外的工作或責任）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 與「雇用」無關，這裡指承擔更多工作量。文中：Instead, the remaining team members are forced to take on the extra work, which makes it very difficult to maintain high standards of care.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To fail to get the benefits of something.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 錯失、失去（應得的機會或好處）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於日常口語，這裡指病人因系統問題而無法獲得應有的醫療服務。文中：He added that patients should not have to miss out on the care they need just because the NHS failed to plan for predictable staff absences.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To take control of something or to use a space for a different purpose.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「接管公司」，這裡指空間被其他部門佔用。文中：In a recent survey of over 2,000 CSP members, six out of 10 said that their rehabilitation rooms had been taken over by other clinical teams, often because managers did not prioritize their work.

previousArticles.title: NHS Trusts Face Funding Gaps for Maternity Leave
previousArticles.summaryEn: New data shows nearly half of NHS trusts in England do not have specific budgets to pay for maternity leave cover. This issue is particularly bad for physiotherapy departments, which are often treated worse than nursing teams. When staff go on leave without replacements, remaining workers must handle extra tasks. This leads to longer waiting times and worse care for patients who need rehabilitation. Experts are now calling on the government to fix these funding gaps and end hiring freezes.

quiz.question: What is the specific difference in maternity coverage between physiotherapy and nursing departments according to the report?

options.A: Nursing departments have a 49% rate of no maternity coverage.
options.B: Physiotherapy services are twice as likely to lack maternity cover compared to nursing.
options.C: Nursing departments have no specific budget for maternity leave, unlike physiotherapy.
options.D: Over 20% of nursing departments provide no maternity cover for their staff.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第三段指出，超過五分之一（即 20% 以上）的信託機構不為物理治療師提供產假替代人力，而護理職位僅有 9% 的機構回報有類似的缺口。因此物理治療缺乏覆蓋的比例（>20%）確實約為護理（9%）的兩倍。選項 A 錯誤，因為 49% 是所有信託機構的平均值而非僅針對護理。選項 C 與文章事實相反。選項 D 錯誤，因為 20% 以上缺口的是物理治療而非護理。

quiz.question: Based on the article, why might the physiotherapy workforce be disproportionately affected by the lack of maternity funding?

options.A: Because physiotherapists require more expensive equipment than other departments.
options.B: Because the high percentage of women in the field makes maternity leave a frequent occurrence.
options.C: Because physiotherapy teams have been forced to move to smaller rehabilitation rooms.
options.D: Because physiotherapy is considered less essential than nursing by hospital managers.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第四段提到，女性佔物理治療工作人力約 79%，這使得產假成為該專業中極為普遍且可預測的現象。由於該領域女性比例極高，缺乏產假預算規劃對其造成的衝擊遠大於其他性別比例較平均的部門。選項 A 與 C 雖然文章有提到相關困難，但並非導致「產假資金缺口」影響重大的直接原因。選項 D 為推論過度，文章並未明言物理治療被視為不重要，僅提到其資源分配受到忽視。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'essential' mean in the context of 'keep essential services running smoothly'?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境中，essential 指的是「不可或缺的」或「基礎且必要的」，意指維持 NHS 運作中不可或缺的服務項目。選項 B 錯誤，essential 與昂貴無關。選項 C 雖然物理治療很專業，但 essential 在此處強調的是服務的「必要性」而非「專業深度」。選項 D 錯誤，essential 並未暗示服務是新創的，反而是指長期以來維持醫療體系運作的核心服務。

quiz.question: What is the primary concern raised by the article regarding the NHS?

options.A: The NHS is failing to recruit enough new physiotherapists to meet demand.
options.B: Patients are choosing private healthcare over the NHS due to long waiting times.
options.C: A lack of maternity leave funding is negatively impacting patient care and staff workload.
options.D: The government is planning to cut all rehabilitation services to save money.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文的核心主旨圍繞在 NHS 缺乏產假替代預算，導致現有員工負擔加重，進而影響病患的照護品質與等待時間，這是文章第一段至最後一段不斷強調的主軸。選項 A 雖然提到招募凍結，但並非全文主旨。選項 B 文中未提及病患轉向私人醫療。選項 D 為錯誤資訊，文中僅提到資源分配不均與空間被佔用，並未提到政府計劃刪除復健服務。
